observations: Brand name 'AMAZE' is printed on the side in photo 0.
Significant corrosion and paint peeling around the base rim in photos 0 and 1.
Standard brass valve assembly is visible.
Size appears to be a standard domestic 12.5kg cylinder based on proportions.

claims.evidence: Requires a pressure test or connection to an appliance to verify seal and flow.
Photos 0 and 1 show heavy rust at the base which requires scraping, treating, and repainting for safety.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired; gas cylinders have a limited certified lifespan.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud/handle.

risks.risk: Deep corrosion at the base may have compromised the structural integrity or caused pinhole leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the base after the loose rust has been brushed away.

risks.risk: The valve may leak or be seized.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being opened and closed, or a soap-bubble test while pressurized.

proof_requests: Photo of the stamped markings on the handle showing the weight (kg) and the manufacture/expiry date.
Close-up photo of the rusted base to see the depth of the pitting.
Video of the valve being operated.
response.reason: The item is a clearly identified gas cylinder. While there are significant safety risks due to visible rust and unknown age, it can be priced at a worst-case value (scrap or refurbishment cost).
